outcome: women's experience of being in control
utility of the plan to facilitate communication
midwives' perceptions of the plan's value
cohort: The study included 294 women who utilised hospital-initiated birth plans for their scheduled caesarean section and 18 midwives who provided care to these women.
finding: Using a formal birth plan for elective caesarean birth has utility in supporting women to effect choice and control, particularly when communication is enhanced.
mod_finding: The study specifically focused on the utility of birth plans in the context of elective caesarean birth, finding they support woman-centred care for this mode of birth.
